The structure of K4Hg2Sb4 (reduced formula K2HgSb2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pna2_1 (No. 33), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Hg 4-vertex polyhedra and Sb 6-vertex polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between K 8-vertex and Sb 6-vertex polyhedra.
